name: Szulimán (Hungary)
description: Light grey field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szulimán: a green shield with a bunch of grapes, with a helm, green and yellow mantling and a scroll inscribed SZULIMÁN.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szulimán arms with helm, mantling and scroll
